content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from entertainmenttonightSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog inentertainmenttonightVerified•FollowMore optionsentertainmenttonightVerified Edited•6d'The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives' stars Jessi Draper and Jordan Ngatikaura are getting a divorce.⁠ ⁠ According to court records, Jordan has filed for divorce from his wife of five years. The couple share two children: Jagger, 6, and Jovi, 3.⁠ ⁠"This has not been an easy decision and it comes with a heavy heart," Jordan said in a statement to ET. "I’m grateful for the shared memories and the lessons. While our paths are now moving in different directions, my priority remains my children and ensuring they feel loved, supported, and protected through this transition. I am committed to handling this next chapter with kindness and respect."⁠When ET caught up with Jessi a little over two weeks ago ahead of the season four premiere of 'SLOMW,' she said they were back together after separating."We've been back together for almost a year, but we're still working on it. We're still in therapy," she said.
